_README: Registry for the source preflight. See references/protocols/source-preflight.md.
One entry per source key — use the same <PLACEHOLDER> keys the skills already
label   Human name for the table.
auth    'oauth' | 'token' | 'none'. Mark 'oauth' when the refresh needs a
browser — those cannot be repaired by an unattended run.
check   Shell command. Exit 0 = live. Non-zero = failed, and the command
prints one reason word from the closed list on stdout or stderr:
Make the cheapest REAL call the source offers — one record, one page.
A set environment variable is not a working credential.
timeout Seconds before the check is abandoned and scored 'unreachable'.
fix     One line telling the user how to repair it. Shown on failure.
enabled Set true once you have filled in a real check.
Never print a secret from a check. Print the reason word, nothing else.
The two entries below are shape examples and are disabled.

<TASK_TRACKER>.label: Task tracker
<TASK_TRACKER>.check: curl -sf -m 8 -o /dev/null -H "Authorization: $TRACKER_TOKEN" "$TRACKER_API/issues?limit=1" || { [ -z "$TRACKER_TOKEN" ] && echo no-credential || echo unreachable; exit 1; }
<TASK_TRACKER>.fix: Re-run /connect-mcps connect to <your tracker>, or refresh TRACKER_TOKEN.

<CALENDAR>.label: Calendar
<CALENDAR>.fix: OAuth refresh needs a browser. Run the check by hand once from an interactive session to re-consent.
